answer: I'd like to talk about an instrument I've wanted to play for as long as I can remember. A musical instrument I have long wanted to learn is the piano, which I have always found genuinely [[captivating]]. There is something about its rich, versatile sound that appeals to me enormously. It can sound gentle and calm one moment and powerful the next, and I think that range is what [[draws me to it]]. The main reason I want to learn it is that I have always regretted never pursuing music as a child. Music has always been a big part of my life; I listen to it on my way to work and while I read, but I've only ever been a listener, never a player. I imagine learning it would be both challenging and deeply [[rewarding]]. As for how I'd learn, I would probably start with online lessons and gradually move to a proper teacher, since patience and consistency are essential. Pianos are quite rare in my town, so I'd begin with a small digital keyboard in my room and practise for half an hour each evening. I know progress would be slow at first, requiring real [[perseverance]]. Still, the thought of one day being able to play a piece I love is genuinely exciting. I think playing an instrument would also be a wonderful way to relax and express myself. I can even imagine playing simple tunes for my little nephew when my elder sister visits from Dhaka. Honestly, I believe it would be a hugely [[fulfilling]] hobby that I could enjoy for the rest of my life. It is definitely something I intend to make time for once my schedule allows.

followUps.q: Did you learn any music at school?
followUps.answer: Very little, apart from singing the national anthem and a few songs for cultural programmes. Music wasn't really treated as a serious subject, which I think was a [[missed opportunity]].

followUps.q: Is there any other instrument you'd like to learn?
followUps.answer: Perhaps the harmonium, because it's so central to traditional Bengali music. My grandmother loves old songs played on it, so learning it would let me play for her in the village.
